# acloud_maintenance_schedule (Data Source)

Get a maintenance schedule by its identity

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acloud_maintenance_schedule" "weekend" {
  organisation = "example-org"                          # required for this data source
  id           = "5c1e2d3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f" # identity of the schedule
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organisation` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Required here, even when the provider sets `organisation`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the maintenance schedule
- `windows` (List of Object) Maintenance windows of the schedule, each with `day`, `start_time` (local time, `HH:mm`) and `duration` (in minutes). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows))

<a id="nestedatt--windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows`

Read-Only:

- `day` (String)
- `duration` (Number)
- `start_time` (String)
